code.status_enum: app.schemas.common.WorkflowStageStatus (aliased as WorkflowFilterStatus; single source, no second enum)

date_from.description: Inclusive lower bound on the report dataset row date.

date_to.description: Inclusive upper bound on the report dataset row date.

direction_ids.description: Universities linked (via university_programs -> it_programs.direction_id) to one of these IT directions.

product_ids.description: Universities linked via university_products.product_id (product, never vendor).

responsible_ids.description: Universities linked via the canonical M:N university_responsibles.

workflow_statuses.description: Universities whose canonical workflow runtime (workflow_instances + instance_stages) matches one of these stage statuses.

allowed_workflow_statuses.current: Derived: the instance has a live runtime pointer (workflow_instances.current_instance_stage_id IS NOT NULL).
allowed_workflow_statuses.overdue: Derived: an open stage (not completed/skipped) with due_date before today and completed_at IS NULL.

workflow_status_note: workflow_statuses filters canonical instance STAGE runtime (instance_stages), not the workflow_instances.status header column (production only ever writes 'active' there, so it carries no filtering signal). Legacy app/modules/workflow tables are never used.

date_semantics.decision: date_from/date_to are inclusive bounds on the INTERACTION period. A university is selected when it has at least one interaction inside the range: EXISTS a meetings row with meeting_at in range OR EXISTS an interaction_notes row with created_at in range (day precision, UTC).
date_semantics.source: ТЗ: 'отчёты по взаимодействиям с вузами за выбранный период'. Both interaction sources are OR-combined inside a single EXISTS, so the selected university set is identical for reports, preview, export and statistics.
date_semantics.row_grain: The period decides WHETHER a university is in the selection, not how many rows it yields. Rows keep the dataset grain University LEFT JOIN License (one row per license + one fallback row per license-less university). A university with several interactions in the range still appears as its own set of grain rows, not one row per interaction. A detailed 'one interaction = one row' journal requires a separate product decision and contract change.
date_semantics.no_interaction: A university with no meetings and no interaction notes is excluded as soon as any date bound is set. With both bounds null the period is not applied and interaction-less universities stay visible.
date_semantics.indexes: Served by the existing composites ix_meetings_univ_meeting_at (university_id, meeting_at) and ix_interaction_notes_univ_created (university_id, created_at).

empty_list_semantics: [] (or null, normalized to []) means the dimension filter is not applied. Empty lists are never WHERE FALSE.
duplicate_ids: Duplicate IDs are deduplicated preserving first-seen order; semantics are unchanged for IN queries.
date_range_validation: date_from <= date_to is enforced. A reversed range is a 422 validation error (Pydantic ValidationError for bodies; HTTPException 422 with the Pydantic error detail for query params).

query_params.style: Repeated params for multi-select: ?university_ids=<uuid1>&university_ids=<uuid2>. Same names and types as the DTO fields.

security: The filter object never widens access. The caller's data scope (CurrentUser.university_ids) is applied independently and conjunctively (AND): a scoped user requesting a foreign university receives zero rows. Unparseable scope entries are dropped; an empty scope fails closed.
pagination: Pagination is a separate contract and is NOT part of UnifiedFilter.
notes: No new DB migration (contract/service task only).
Existing P1 catalog endpoints are untouched (additive path; full endpoint wiring belongs to P4-01-02).
